title: Remote MCP OAuth path format, generated surface, and write inventory guard

phases.objective: Keep future OpenAPI, Custom GPT surface, OAuth, and Remote MCP write paths fail-closed, semantically synchronized, and covered by deterministic local and CI contracts without activating write scopes or treating observability-only inventory counters as semantic drift.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository maintainer and deterministic CI guard
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A changed OpenAPI, OAuth, Custom GPT surface, migration, route, workflow, semantic-currentness verifier, or write-inventory artifact is evaluated by the local path guard and its required contract tests.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Every source operation is marker-covered or explicitly excluded, generated registries match their source fingerprints, the Remote MCP write inventory is semantically current with write activation disabled, and parity contracts pass.
steps: Load the canonical OpenAPI source, Custom GPT surface registry, operation registry, write-scope inventory, and registered derived-state semantic-currentness contract.
Check source-operation marker and exclusion coverage against the historical baseline so a new unmarked path fails closed.
Regenerate and compare operation and surface artifacts without applying migrations or calling providers.
Regenerate the Remote MCP inventory in scratch space and compare its semantic projection, ignoring only the explicitly reviewed observability-only file_count and tracked-files-scanned Markdown row.
Run OAuth token exchange, activation coverage, mutation governance, inventory self-test, and shared-policy parity fixtures.
Report deterministic pass or fail evidence with no write-scope activation and no secret values.
assertions: A new source OpenAPI operation requires a surface marker or a bounded exclusion record.
Operation registry and generated artifacts must match the current source fingerprint.
unclassified_write_route_count remains zero and write activation remains disabled.
Remote MCP route, scope, policy, or classification drift remains merge-blocking even when observability-only file_count drift is ignored.
The workflow and local path guard use the registered semantic currentness verifier rather than a raw byte-level inventory check.
Tenant GPT OAuth token exchange remains PKCE S256-bound and testable without a live provider or database migration.
Internal OAuth, SSO, and scope-catalog ledgers remain outside tenant or admin activation surfaces.
All checks are deterministic, bounded, read-only, and secret-free.

phases.objective: Observe the guard and external readiness contracts on an exact staging candidate without enabling provider or internal writes.
Exercise stale semantic artifacts, concurrent refresh, ingress drift, and path-registry conflicts with bounded recovery evidence.
Run the exact read-only OAuth and MCP client canaries against an authorized non-production endpoint.
Require independent approval, production ingress attestation, live database readiness, and rollback evidence before any production advertisement or write activation.
